page.notes: Running head is partly doubtful ("De iusta" may read "De fiusta" or similar; "sive recta Ratione" uncertain). Doubtful readings: "næ" at the start of the page, "ea" in "secundum ea sententiam", "sic" in "audacius, sic firmet", "suam" in the italic passage (the letter looks like J), and "pra" in "pra quibus" (possibly pro or præ). The catchword "autem" is set at the lower right. The strip at the right edge is the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.
